Landed 61d183b. SQLite lives in a worker thread, never on the Gateway main thread. The worker creates the directory at 0700 and the file at 0600, tightens either one if it already exists looser, sets WAL, and applies 0001-initial in its own transaction. A worker error or exit rejects pending calls, reports once, and the next call opens one replacement. stop terminates a worker that does not close within 5 seconds. The smoke proves the Gateway stays up and family.week still answers when the store cannot open, then reopens with the same 0001 row. Review shipped and arch agreed.
